Called out SSO, HSM attestation, and a <50ms p99 requirement as potential blockers. Can we turn a tight pack around by Thu EOD?

SecBot: Uploaded Nyla_Security_Q_2026.xlsx to Drives -> https://drive.redwood/internal/nyla/RFI. Checklist attached.

Carlos: CSV stub I'll add to the pack: feature,hosted,dedicated,private; SLA,99.9,99.95,customer-defined; HSM,managed KMS,BYO HSM,On-prem KMIP; SSO,Yes,Yes,Yes; p99 typical,~40-90ms,~20-45ms,Depends on infra.
